This is interesting. The check is:
```c
if( (last_errno != 33 && last_errno != 34)
    && (last_errno > 0 || last_errno < -44 || point_count == 1
        || transient_error[-last_errno] == 0 ) )
```

The `transient_error[-last_errno]` is only evaluated when `last_errno <= 0` AND `last_errno >= -44` AND `point_count != 1`. So `-last_errno` is in range [0, 44], which is within the 50-element array. So this is bounded.

Hmm. Let me reconsider. The issue is "array lookup with wrong indices due to missing validation before accessing the array". Let me look at the `pj_fwd` / `pj_inv` path and the `pj_obs_api.c` or the `proj_trans` path. Actually, let me look at the fuzzer harness more carefully to understand what input format is expected and what functions get called.
